ambiguity: Title/body read as a broken upload feature with a 'server fault' and pasted server logs containing a WARN stack trace (Unknown system setting 'openai-config') -> D is plausible; B (file exceeds the admin-configured upload limit) is also plausible; C only if you notice what is missing from the logs. Body never mentions nginx, a proxy, 413 or file size (413 only appears in a later comment).
decisive_code: api/v1/resource.go:UploadResource (POST /api/v1/resource/blob, called from web/src/helpers/api.ts) — backend default limit is 32 MiB (GetWorkspaceSettingWithDefaultValue '32') and oversize files get a 400 'File size exceeds allowed limit', never a silent failure; server/server.go registers echo LoggerWithConfig which logs every request (method/uri/status/error). The pasted logs cover the upload attempt yet contain no /api/v1/resource/blob request at all, and the 'Unknown system setting name' WARN in api/v1/system.go:GetSystemStatus is a harmless default-branch log on /api/v1/status (status=200). So the upload never reached memos -> something in front of it (reverse proxy body-size limit).
notes: nginx default client_max_body_size 1m rejected uploads >1MB with 413 before reaching memos; no code change.

reviews.decidable_why: Server logs show no upload request reaching memos at all, which hints at a proxy block, but the 413 only appeared in a later comment.
The pasted server logs are unrelated (the request never reached memos), and no proxy or 413 is mentioned in the body.
